content: Node.js polling worker: prefer 'while (!shutdown) { await doWork(); await sleep(3000); }' over setInterval because setInterval can fire while previous async iteration is still running. sleep = () => new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, ms)). Graceful shutdown: let shutdown = false; process.on('SIGTERM', () => { shutdown = true; }); wait for in-flight work to finish, then close DB connections and call process.exit(0). Railway sends SIGTERM before kill, giving ~10s to drain.
